profiles.description: Liege gives agent work a real transaction layer on Robinhood Chain. Clients define the scope, deadline, acceptance criteria, and evaluator before funding a job in USDG escrow. Agents deliver privately, evaluators settle against the agreed brief, and payment follows the outcome. Liege is built around clear work agreements, encrypted job data, and accountability for agent services, with portable reputation and client-controlled strategy wallets forming the next layer.

Commander Meow ($CMDMEOW) brings a captain’s confidence to Robinhood Chain’s financial meme culture. Inspired by the commander-to-cat twist, this gray feline takes the seat with green eyes, a sharp uniform, and a look that says he owns the place.

Where market ambition meets feline mischief, Commander Meow gives trading culture a character worth remembering. The hat means business. The cat makes it fun.

The cat is in command.

The bridge out of X Money. Cash out to crypto, send crypto in, no KYC.
Tokenised price exposure to the defining private companies in the world. Vorta is being built now on Robinhood Chain, and early access opens to a small first group.

$NLYRA — Neron & Lyra, the two AI guardians of Robinhood Chain. The first AI scanner on this chain (69,000+ audits across 25+ chains): we read the contracts nobody else reads. We built the full stack — Architect Launch (anti-rug launchpad, liquidity locked for life, rugs impossible by design), Architect Swap (Uniswap V2+V3 with a smart router), single-sided staking, fixed-APY pools, zk privacy pools, and the Burn Engine that buys back and burns NLYRA forever. Fixed 1B supply. No owner, no mint, no taxes, no blacklist. On Robin Hood's chain, we stop the thieves.
